subject: May 17 discovery — token volumes & trial credit request
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Will Park <will.park@novus-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: May 17 discovery — token volumes & trial credit request

Hi Will / Sara —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + two asks so we have alignment going into the pilot: 

Recap (from our call)
- Scope: conversational search + short-form generation for product pages (customer-facing).
- Expected pilot volume: 50-70M tokens/month during a 6-week proof-of-concept; production could reach ~180M tokens/month if we move forward.
- Latency SLO: 350–450ms p50 for generation flows (business-critical on peak).
- Security: data will flow through our hosted API; Novus needs SOC2 + retention controls (we'll surface evidence).

Pricing posture you mentioned
- Pilot budget: ~$30k total for the POC window.
- Long-run target: ideally < $1,200 per 1M tokens (we heard this as a target range from procurement).

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the 50–70M pilot window and the $30k pilot budget? Knowing the precise burn expectation helps us size the credit.
2) If that lines up, would you like a one-time trial credit to cover the expected pilot burn while we iterate? We can propose a conditional $12k–$18k credit (covers roughly 15–20M tokens at our pilot pricing) as an operational safety net while procurement is finishing paperwork.

I've attached a short estimate (redwood_estimate_may17.xlsx) with two pricing scenarios: conservative (higher perf instance) and conservative+batching (lower $/1M). If you prefer, we can swap to a dedicated capacity cadence for lower unit price during production.

I'll loop Ben and Laura for credit/finance + any approval notes. If we get a quick confirm on volumes/budget, I'll ask Finance for a pilot top-up and schedule a check-in for week 2 of the pilot.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood_estimate_may17.xlsx, pilot_prompt_set.txt
From: Will Park <will.park@novus-retail.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Kim <sara.kim@novus-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 17 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: May 17 discovery — token volumes & trial credit request

Thanks, Chloe — good recap and appreciated the estimator. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot target: we expect spiky traffic but estimate 60M tokens/month on average during the POC (with short bursts up to 90M).
- Budget: procurement allocated $30k but that is locked to the pilot window only; we cannot commit to higher spend without a formal quote.
- Long-term: procurement pushed back on the $1,200/1M target — they asked whether we can get unit economics closer to $900–$1,000/1M at scale (60–180M/month bands).

We definitely want a trial credit — that will let engineering iterate faster. For the pilot we would ask for a $15k credit to cover initial testing and first two sprints. 

If you can confirm what $15k buys at the pilot pricing (tokens covered) and any gating conditions (e.g., data retention SLA accepted, PO signed), we can fast-track procurement paperwork.

—Will
Will Park
Head of Product, Novus Retail
will.park@novus-retail.com | +1 212-555-0147
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: May 17 discovery — token volumes & trial credit request

Chloe / Ben —

We can approve a conditional pilot credit of $15,000 to Novus Retail with the following conditions: 
- Credit valid for 6 weeks from the pilot start date.
- Credit will be applied to usage billed at our pilot-hosted rate (see attached estimator).
- Procurement must execute the standard MSA and a short SOW that covers data retention and logging terms (SOC2 evidence already uploaded to your drive link).
- If usage exceeds the credit before the pilot end, standard billing applies unless a PO is received that bridges overage.

Operationally, $15k at the pilot pricing maps to ~18.2M tokens (pilot-rate) or ~27.3M tokens if their flows leverage prefix caching + aggressive batching. We recommend we offer both mappings to set expectations: 
- Conservative: 18.2M tokens (no batching)
- Optimistic: 27.3M tokens (with cache/batching guidelines that we'll share)

Ben — please prepare a short note for PO acceptance and send the credit letter once Chloe confirms pilot start date. Rishi — noting you on the CC for awareness.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Will Park <will.park@novus-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: May 17 discovery — token volumes & trial credit request

Will — great, thanks for the quick confirmation. That lines up well. 

Summary of what we agreed and next steps: 
1) Pilot volume: 60M tokens/month estimate (with spikes to 90M).
2) Trial credit: Redwood will provide a one-time $15,000 credit for the 6-week pilot window. Conservative mapping: ~18.2M tokens; optimistic mapping with caching/batching: ~27.3M tokens.
3) Conditions: Novus to sign the MSA + SOW (Laura uploaded the template to the HubSpot deal — link below).
4) Finance ops: Ben will send the credit letter and invoice template for procurement to attach to the PO.
5) Check-in cadence: Chloe + Will weekly sync (end of week) — first check-in scheduled for Tue, May 25 at 10:00 AM PT; agenda: burn-to-date, perf snapshots, prompt set tweaks.

Will — can you confirm acceptance of the credit terms and whether Tue 5/25 10:00 AM PT works for the first check-in? Once you confirm, Ben will trigger the credit letter and we will start the pilot clock.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Novus running.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
